findings.title: Current weather always lapses before a replacement can be requested (quarter-hour authority gap)
findings.evidence: probes/B/wx-quarter-gap-probe.cjs: no fetch while selected; unselected at 06:30:00.001 and 06:45:00.001; first refreshing polls 06:30:20 and 06:45:20. Issue #11 certificate section 3: delivered-page header unavailable about 2 s and 23 s at quarter-hour boundaries.
findings.materiality: Predicted cloud-deck disappearance/pop and precipitation stop every 15 min under cloudy or rainy weather (continuity / no-slideshow gates); visual not observed (clear sky). Pre-existing before the window.
openQuestions: Owner acceptance of the gap as truthful withdrawal

findings.title: Rejected or unadmittable 200 responses recorded as received in request diagnostics
findings.evidence: probes/B/wx-outcome-probe.cjs: {error:true}, {} and an invalid current give state received, reason null, nothing admitted; HTTP 503 gives unavailable.

findings.title: Legacy siteElev neither target-bound nor reset on location change
findings.materiality: Previous location's elevation modulates star haze/blur until the new location's weather response arrives (indefinitely if it fails).

findings.title: Radar acquisition runs with no product consumer; manifest host unvalidated
findings.evidence: grep: weatherRadar read only by radarEvidence and qaState; R000D ES0D-14; probe dispatched an image to an http:// host; no meta CSP in source.
findings.materiality: Periodic third-party requests revealing a zoom-6 tile location with no product benefit; provider-trust boundary.
openQuestions: Owner intent to keep radar for a future decoder

findings.title: Without a timetable, fresh weather header shows a precipitation condition while clouds/particles are withheld
findings.evidence: Issue #11 certificate section 5 records a 'Rain 24 deg' header without clouds; status unknown.
findings.materiality: Cross-consumer divergence; header remains labelled model estimate.
openQuestions: Is this the intended consumer policy?

findings.title: Units change still takes the broad path (prayer and radar restart)
findings.evidence: CONFIG_EFFECTS units path broad; XF01 smallest-safe-change 'separate weather units from radar' not done.

findings.title: GPS adoption waits on an unbounded permissions.query
findings.materiality: A never-settling permission query would drop a valid fix.
openQuestions: Any browser where query does not settle

findings.title: Preview forecast substitution has no track age bound
findings.materiality: Long fast-forward previews use an arbitrarily old track; output labelled SIM/forecast.

findings.title: Nominatim place/boundary preference may be inert (class vs category)
findings.evidence: Contract notes unresolved naming; no provider contacted.
